item.title: Moving database stores (docker/PostgreSQL)
item.author: paul@insightsforaction.uk (Paul Hewson)
item.description:
Moving a PostgreSQL data store for a Docker contained server

I had to free up space on the primary OS drive, one target was to take the PostgreSQL Docker container and reconfigure to store its persistent data directory on a dedicated external volume (~HOME/data/).

item.title: Managing migrations with sqitch
item.author: paul@insightsforaction.uk (Paul Hewson)
item.description:
From Pexels Wendy Wei

I do have one little problem with sqitch. I am so used to typing a letter u after a letter q that I regularly mistype the command as squitch, and then end up staring at the terminal for so long I wonder if I should have typed sqint. Very minor naming issues aside, the project has a website at www.sqitch.org. I’ve found it a simple and specific database migration tool which does as much as I want and no more.
